title: Which Area? — A Radio Segment
gist_ar: فقرة راديو بتقارن بين منطقتين للسكن، وكل واحدة أحسن لنوع مختلف من الناس.

before_listening.en: A radio programme compares two areas of the city. Listen for the presenter's CONCLUSION, not the details.
before_listening.ar: فقرة راديو بتقارن بين منطقتين. ركّز على الخلاصة اللي المذيعة وصلت لها، مش التفاصيل.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: You're listening to Cairo Today. This week's question: where should you rent your first flat? We compared two areas. Maadi is quieter than Nasr City, and the streets are greener, but it is also more expensive, about two thousand pounds more every month. Nasr City is busier and noisier, but the buses are faster and the shops are cheaper. If you work in the centre, Nasr City is closer. If you have small children, Maadi is safer in the evening. So the answer is not simple. Maadi is more comfortable, Nasr City is more practical. Choose the area that is better for your life, not the one that looks better in photos.

options: Maadi is better than Nasr City for everybody
Neither area is good for a first flat
Each area is better for a different kind of person

questions.q: Which area does she call safer in the evening?
questions.q_ar: أنهي منطقة قالت إنها أأمن بالليل؟
